cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(devdash_test_components)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp_components REQUIRED)
add_library(devdash_probe SHARED src/probe.cpp)
ament_target_dependencies(devdash_probe rclcpp rclcpp_components)
rclcpp_components_register_nodes(devdash_probe "devdash_test::Probe")
install(TARGETS devdash_probe LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
ament_package()
